title: Ravi and the Ocean's Secret
description: Ravi, a curious little boy, discovers a mysterious bottle on the beach and follows its clues to a hidden treasure.

scenes.description: Ravi walking along the beach at sunset
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, walking along golden sandy beach, gentle ocean waves, warm sunset light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: रवि को समुद्र के किनारे टहलना पसंद था क्योंकि लहरों की आवाज़ उसे सुकून देती थी और हर दिन कुछ नया दिखाती थी।
scenes.subtitle: Ravi loves walking by the sea because the sound of the waves calms him and shows him something new every day.

scenes.description: Ravi noticing a bottle half-buried in the sand
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, noticing a glass bottle half-buried in golden sand, warm sunset light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: एक दिन, रवि ने रेत में आधी दबी हुई बोतल देखी, जैसे समुद्र ने उसे कोई खास तोहफ़ा दिया हो।
scenes.subtitle: One day, Ravi saw a bottle half-buried in the sand, as if the sea had gifted him something special.

scenes.description: Ravi opening the bottle and finding a rolled-up map inside
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, opening glass bottle and pulling out rolled-up old treasure map, warm sunset light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: बोतल के अंदर उसे एक पुराना नक्शा मिला, जैसे किसी समुद्री डाकू ने उसे छुपा कर रखा हो।
scenes.subtitle: Inside the bottle, he found an old map, as if a pirate had hidden it there.

scenes.description: Ravi following the map through the palm trees
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, walking through tall palm trees holding treasure map, golden light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: नक्शे के सहारे वह ऊँचे नारियल के पेड़ों के बीच से गुज़रा, जैसे वह किसी रोमांचक सफर पर हो।
scenes.subtitle: Following the map, he walked through tall coconut trees, as if he was on an exciting journey.

scenes.description: Ravi finding a small wooden chest under a tree
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, finding small wooden chest under large palm tree, warm light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: पेड़ के नीचे उसे एक छोटा लकड़ी का संदूक मिला, जो समय और रहस्यों से भरा हुआ लग रहा था।
scenes.subtitle: Under the tree, he found a small wooden chest that seemed filled with time and secrets.

scenes.description: Ravi opening the chest and finding seashells and a glowing pearl
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot, little Indian boy, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, shorts, barefoot, opening small wooden chest filled with colorful seashells and glowing pearl, warm sunset light, storybook style)
scenes.narration: संदूक खोलते ही उसमें रंग-बिरंगे सीप और एक चमकता हुआ मोती मिला, जैसे समुद्र ने अपनी सबसे कीमती चीज़ उसे सौंप दी हो।
scenes.subtitle: As he opened the chest, he found colorful shells and a glowing pearl, as if the ocean had given him its most precious gift.
